name: South Gate City Council - Special Meeting
minutes_text:
CITY  OF SOUTH  GATE
  SPECIAL  CITY  COUNCIL  MEETING
  MINUTES
  TUESDAY,  OCTOBER  22, 2024

CALL  TO ORDER  Gil Hurtado,  Mayor called a Special City Council  Meeting  to order at 5:30 p.m.

ROLL  CALL  Yodit  Glaze,  City  Clerk

PRESENT  Mayor  Gil Hurtado,  Vice  Mayor  Maria  Davila,  Council  Member  Maria  del
  Pilar  Avalos,  and Council  Member  AI Rios;  City  Treasurer  Jose De La
  Paz, City Manager  Rob Houston,  City  Attorney  Rail  F. Salinas

ABSENT/EXCUSE  Council  Member  Joshua Barron

1

PROCLAMATION  The City  Council  issued  a Proclamation  declaring  National  Breast
  Cancer  Awareness  Month.

2

PROCLAMATION  The City  Council  issued  a Proclamation  recognizing  November  11,
  2024,  as Veterans  Day  honoring  those  who  have  served  our Nation  in
  the Armed  Forces.

3

CERTIFICATES  The City  Council  presented  Certificates  of Appreciation  to South
  Gate  High  School,  South  East  High  School  and Legacy  High  School
  students  in recognition  for their  participation  in the 2024  Student
  Governrnent  Day.

4
PERSONNEL  RECRUITMENT

& SELECTION  The City  Council  received  and filed  the list of new and promoted  full-
  time  employees  hired  or promoted  during  September  2024.

  Mayor  Hurtado  asked if anyone  in the audience  wished  to speak and any
  emails  received  on any of these items.

  Mario  Dominguez,  Jr., requesting  detail  information  on the closed  session

  items.

  Mike  Ramirez,  President  of the MEA,  Joanna Monterroza,  Vice  President

  of the PMMA,  and Charles  Leone,  Coordinator  with  SEIU  Local  721

  asked for Council's  support.

  Having  no one else come forward,  Mayor  Hurtado  closed  the audience
  portion.

  Vice  Mayor  Davila  recused  herself  from  item 2 due to the proximately  of

  her residence.

  The Council  Members  recessed  into Closed  Session  at 6:18 p.m. and
  reconvened  at 7:10 p.m. with  four (4) Members  of Council  present.

  Council  Member  Barron  was absent.  City  Attorney  Salinas  reported  the

  following:

  at a future City Council meeting.

  On item  2, a motion  was made  by Mayor  Hurtado  and seconded  by
  Councilwoman  Avalos  and on a vote  of 3-0, the City  Council  approved  a
  tentative  settlement  in that matter.  The amount  of the settlement  will  be
  disclosed  pursuant  to the Brown  Act.

  3.  CONFERENCE  WITH  LABOR  NEGOTIATOR
  Pursuant  to Government  Code  Section  54957.6

  Agency  Representation:  Rob  Houston,  City  Manager

  Employee  Organizations:  SGPMMA,  SGMEA

  On item  3, the City  Council  received  a presentation  by it's  representatives
  and upon  completion  of that presentation  guidance  was given  by the City
  Council  but there  was no reportable  action  taken.

  Mayor  Hurtado  asked  if anyone  in the audience  wished  to speak  and any
  emails  received  on any of these  items.

  Mario  Dominguez,  Jr., is unsatisfied  with  the lack  of information  on the
  closed  session  items.

  Having  no one else come  forward,  Mayor  Hurtado  closed  the audience
  portion.

  City  Attorney  Salinas  stated  that the public  have  a right  to voice  their
  opinion  and the City  respective  everyone's  first  amendment  rights.

ADJOURNMENT  Vice  Mayor  Davila  adjourned  the meeting  at 7:16  p.m.  and seconded  by
  Mayor  Hurtado.

PASSED  and APPROVED  this 26"' day of November  2024.
